summary: Montgomery County, TX Texas Forest Service tower about 100 ft tall per a 1952 survey recovery note; indexed as gone, with no removal date or site description found.

facts.design: Four-legged steel structure set on a concrete base, supporting a cab; about 100 ft overall
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association index marks it Tower Gone; no removal date or site description found

events.note: A survey note says the station is probably the same as the Ben Milam Lookout Tower (T.F.S.) and prints 1942 beside that name; the year is not explained
Coast and Geodetic Survey station recovery note (1952) describes the steel structure and cab, about 100 ft overall, about 13 miles ESE of Conroe

evidence.supports: name, county and Forest Lookouts listing for the tower
location about 13 miles ESE of Conroe
evidence.quote: THE STATION IS LOCATED ABOUT 13 MILES EAST SOUTHEAST OF CONROE.

evidence.supports: National Geodetic Survey as the source of the description
design: four-legged steel structure on concrete base supporting cab; 100 ft overall height
evidence.quote: IT IS 4-LEGGED STEEL STRUCTURE SET IN A CONCRETE BASE SUPPORTING THE CAB PROPER. IT HAS AN OVERALL HEIGHT OF 100 FEET AND THE APEX OF THE CAB WAS THE POINT OBSERVED UPON.

evidence.supports: page credits the Texas Forest Service as the agency
survey note saying the station is probably the Ben Milam Lookout Tower (T.F.S.), with 1942 printed beside the name
evidence.quote: PROBABLY THE SAME STATION AS BEN MILAM LOOKOUT TOWER (T.F.S.), 1942.

evidence.supports: station recovered by Coast and Geodetic Survey in 1952
evidence.quote: RECOVERY NOTE BY COAST AND GEODETIC SURVEY 1952 (RLE)

notes_for_editor: Brief height (30.5 m) matches the survey's about 100 ft, so no correction. The 1942 date appears only beside the 'probably the same station' note; the story does not treat it as a build year. No build date, staffing, fire history, removal date or site description found. Two WebSearch calls: the 'Ben Milam' hits were about the Texas Revolution figure, unrelated. TFS history page returned 403. No photos added.
